The *Adhikaraṇavāra* (Pvr 2.6) is an analytical section of the *Parivāra*, the concluding book of the Pali *Vinaya Piṭaka*. Rendered as "The legal issues to which each offense belongs," the text provides a systematic scholastic classification that relates the various Vinaya disciplinary rules to the four categories of monastic legal procedures (*adhikaraṇa*). An English translation of the text has been made available by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
